description: Search U.S. building permits by location (city, state, ZIP code, or a lat/lng radius), category, status, property type, filing or issue date range, estimated project value, contractor name, or free text. Returns up to 25 permits per call with address, dates, category, status, estimated value, contractor and description, plus the total number of matches. Response fields: `total` is exact unless `total_capped` is true, in which case it is a lower bound; when `total_unknown` is true the count could not be computed and `total` is null. `account_window_clamped`, `account_window_days` and `account_window_from` are set when the connected account covers a limited date range, and the results then cover only that range. Category HVAC also matches MECHANICAL, and MECHANICAL also matches HVAC. date_after/date_before match whichever date a permit has (issued, else filed), for feeds that publish only one of the two. Results carry no property owner name, owner mailing address or permit applicant name fields.

category.description: Permit category (case-insensitive). Common values: SOLAR, ROOFING, HVAC, NEW_CONSTRUCTION, POOL, ELECTRICAL, PLUMBING, DEMOLITION, MECHANICAL, RENOVATION.

contractor_name.description: Filter by contractor name (partial match supported)

date_after.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD): only permits dated on or after this date, using the issue date, else the filing date

date_before.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD): only permits dated on or before this date, using the issue date, else the filing date

filed_after.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD): only permits filed on or after this date

filed_before.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD): only permits filed on or before this date

issued_after.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD): only permits issued on or after this date

issued_before.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD): only permits issued on or before this date

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction name or partial name, e.g. 'Wake County', 'Tacoma'

lat.description: Latitude for radius search (use with lng)

lng.description: Longitude for radius search (use with lat)

max_value.description: Maximum estimated project value in dollars

min_value.description: Minimum estimated project value in dollars

property_type.description: Property type, one of: residential, commercial, industrial, mixed_use, institutional, unknown (case-insensitive)

q.description: Free-text search over description, address, and permit number

radius_miles.description: Radius in miles for lat/lng search (max 50, default 5)

start.description: Instead of page: 1-based position of the first result to return, e.g. start=24 continues after result 23 (as named in `_notes`)

name: search_permits
title: Search building permits
